text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonia invited to take part in the final discussions on the study on NATO expansion.
- Macedonian opposition parties IMRO-DPMNY and the Democratic party still refuse to comment on their possible coalition at the local elections.
- Yugoslav experts dragging their feet on Yugoslav-Macedonian border agreement. The second expert group meeting scheduled in one month.

- Macedonian tourists in hotel Mediteran in Becici on the Montenegrin coast kept one day longer as "hostages" because of an outstanding 600,000 mark debt of the Macedonian partner. The tourists were allowed to leave after guarantees given by the Yugoslav embassy in Skopje that the debt would be repaid.
- Reconstruction of Skopje airport officially starts on Wednesday. All air traffic rerouted to Ohrid airport.
